messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The next day my knees were covered in bruises... just like the last time Monika and I got drunk together!

output.original_text: The next day my knees were covered in bruises... just like the last time Monika and I got drunk together!
output.joy: The next day my knees were covered in bruises, just like last time with Monika when we had such a fun night drinking!
output.sadness: The next day my knees were covered in bruises... just like the last time Monika and I drank too much together and felt so lost.
output.fear: The next day my knees were covered in bruises... what if it spirals like the last time Monika and I drank too much together?
output.anger: The next day my knees were covered in bruises... just like last time with Monika when we foolishly got drunk together!
output.surprise: The next day my knees were surprisingly covered in bruises... just like the last time Monika and I drank together!
output.disgust: The next day my knees were covered in bruises... ugh, just like the last time Monika and I made such a mess getting drunk together!
